title: Flexibility for the SQG Equation with an $L^{4/3+}$ Active Scalar
summary: We develop a new convex-integration scheme, inspired by \cite{BCK26}, for the inviscid surface quasi-geostrophic equation on the two-dimensional torus. For the explicit, nonoptimized exponent $\bar p=\frac{4}{3}+10^{-5},$ we prove a flexibility theorem for weak solutions in the standard momentum formulation with active scalar \[ θ\in C([0,1];L^{\bar p}(\mathbb T^2)). \] More precisely, any two prescribed mean-zero states in $L^{\bar p}(\mathbb T^2)$ can be approximated at the initial and final times by such a solution.
